### Local Claude Science — `claude-science-local` skill (first 40 lines)

Path: `C:\Users\Prekzursil\.claude\skills\claude-science-local\SKILL.md`

- Anthropic Claude Science workbench: **no Windows build**. WSL2 Ubuntu daemon **`http://127.0.0.1:8000/`**.
- Dispatcher: `cs` / `pwsh ~/.local/bin/cs.ps1`. Verbs: `open`, `ensure` (`SUCCESS:cs-up` / `FAILED:cs-down`), `status`, `fix`, `doctor`, `backup`, `restore`.
- **HTTP 401 on `/` = ALIVE** (auth gate). Slow/timeout = **WEDGED** (host-RAM / SQLite `operon-cli.db`), not down. `cs fix` recovers.
- Scope **LOCAL only**. MCP connectors in the web UI (HTTP transport). WSL cannot reach Windows stdio MCPs.
